macros.name: plparsep
macros.doc: Space between paragraphs within an item – the \parskip for this environment.

macros.name: plpartopsep
macros.doc: Extra space added to \topsep when environment starts a new paragraph (is called in vmode).

macros.name: pltopsep
macros.doc: Space between first item and preceding paragraph.

macros.name: pointedenum
macros.doc: The option pointedenum and the macro \pointedenum format the labels as in “1.”, “1.1.”, “1.1.1.” and “1.1.1.1.” and the references without the trailing point.

macros.name: setdefaultenum
macros.doc: The labels of enumerated lists are formatted with \setdefaultenum using the mechanism described in Section 3.

macros.name: setdefaultitem
macros.doc: The default labels of itemized environments can be set by using the macro \setdefaultitem which needs four arguments.

macros.name: setdefaultleftmargin
macros.doc: To change the left margin of the lists, use \setdefaultleftmargin.

envs.name: inparablank
envs.doc: The items are set just as regular text.

envs.name: inparaenum
envs.doc: The inparaenum environment formats an enumerated list within a paragraph, just like the one in the introduction.

envs.name: inparaenum
envs.doc: The inparaenum environment formats an enumerated list within a paragraph, just like the one in the introduction.
